artworks.title: Komischer Reiter (Comic Rider)
artworks.medium: pen and ink on laid paper, laid down on mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image features an abstract line drawing of a figure on horseback. The lines outline a rider with an elongated nose and a top hat and a horse with long legs and a minimalistic form. The drawing has a whimsical, almost caricature-like quality, with a sparse use of lines.

artworks.title: Feuer Clown I (Fire Clown)
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper, laid down on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg

artworks.title: Verhexte Tiere (Bewitched Animals)
artworks.medium: graphite on paper, laid down on original mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image displays a series of thin, curving lines and geometric shapes forming an abstract composition. There is a cylindrical shape resembling a windsock on the left, a large tail-like curve extending from an angular form on the right, and a rounded form with a small opening below. Additionally, there is a spherical shape connected to a reclined figure with elongated limbs, and three short vertical lines protruding from a mound in the background.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man
artworks.medium: conte crayon on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's head and upper shoulders viewed in profile, facing to the right. The person is depicted with their head slightly bowed, and they have short to mid-length hair that appears to be slicked back, revealing their ear. The facial features are softly outlined, with a discernible ear, nose, and a hint of a beard. The person's clothing is dark and blends into the equally dark background. The background has a greyish-blue hue and a loose texture. There are no visible jewelry pieces or other objects in the image.

artworks.title: Baum und Architektur--Rhythmen (Tree and Architecture--Rhythms)
artworks.medium: oil on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: This painting displays intersecting lines and block shapes creating an abstract scene. Rectangular grids and curved lines evoke buildings or architectural structures, with two tall shapes on the left and right appearing like tall towers or walls with pointed roofs, and a shape in the center looking like an arch or an opening across a pathway or bridge. These shapes have been painted with black outlines, but within those outlines and overlapping with them are circles of bright green, yellow, pink, red, and dark blue, with some white between the circles. The paint has been applied thickly, with wide, visible brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Scene at a Paris Cafe
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows several people in different poses and positions. On the left, a man is seated with his body visible in a side-facing profile. He is wearing a suit and a tall hat, with his arms crossed on his lap. To his right, there are sketches of three women also seated, wearing dresses with one holding an umbrella. The figures are stylized and the setting appears to be outdoors with minimal background details.

artworks.title: Boats and Gondolas before the Piazza San Marco
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper, mounted on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image portrays a harbor scene with a tall ship in the center, seen from a slightly upward angle. The mast of the ship dominates the composition, stretching towards the sky filled with clouds. The horizon is low, with outlines of ships and architectural structures, including a domed building and a tower on the right, suggesting a distant cityscape. The artwork features loose, expressive brushstrokes that convey motion and spontaneity. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the scene an antiquated quality. The water reflects the ship and surroundings with impressionistic lines, adding to the dynamic harbor setting.

artworks.title: Walking Figure Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: black pen and ink and wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows an impressionistic ink drawing of a person from the upper body to the upper legs. The person seems to be in motion, with one arm raised. Facial features are vague, with minimal details. The hair is represented by dark strokes around the head. The figure is wearing a loose garment with broad strokes for movement. No jewelry or specific objects are present. The background is a lightly textured paper with varying degrees of black ink application.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: red chalk and heightened with white on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: Eight people and six horse heads are drawn in two rows with red and white chalk on tan-colored, horizontally oriented paper. Seven of the people are bearded and muscular. The eighth sits facing away from us, so the gender is unclear. The men twist, turn, bend over, and/or look up in different configurations across the sketches. Two horse heads are along the left edge of the sheet near the bottom corner, and the other four are spaced among the people in the bottom row. Most of the horses pull their chins back toward their powerful necks or twist their heads.

artworks.title: Kneeling Shepherd
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper, with touches of white gouache, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a person crouching with one knee on the ground, facing to the side with their head turned back slightly and their torso twisted. They have short, textured hair and wear a long tunic tied at the waist with a belt, with rolled-up sleeves. One hand is placed over their chest, while the other hand is gripping the hair of a large human head on the ground before them. The person is barefoot, with a speckled cloth draped across their hip. The background features a simple grid pattern.

artworks.title: Orlando and the Thieves
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an outdoor setting, with hanging figures from a tree. The drawing features a rustic and detailed scene. The left portion shows two figures, with one appearing to be assisting another figure to the ground. The right side displays several figures hanging from a tree, with another figure standing nearby and gesturing with a stick or weapon. The linework is sketchy and gestural, capturing a sense of motion and emotion. The composition includes a large tree in the center acting as a dividing element, with hatching techniques used for shading and depth.

artworks.title: Huntsman with a Hound on a Leash
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper, mounted on old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The drawing shows a figure with a dog. The figure is wearing dynamic clothing and holding a stick or staff while one hand reaches towards the dog. The dog is leaping or running next to the figure, both appearing in motion. The sketch highlights the anatomy and posture of the figure and the dog with detailed line work. The background is plain to focus attention on the interaction and motion between the subjects.

artworks.title: A Caricature with Ball Players
artworks.medium: iron gall ink on laid paper, with black ink borders
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstract characters interacting with a ball. The drawing features two stylized figures, each with exaggerated facial features and expressions, positioned on either side of the image. The figure on the left appears to be gesturing or reaching towards the right, with one hand extended and the other arm clad in a patterned sleeve. The figure on the right is holding a large, spherical object, maintaining eye contact with the left figure. Each character exhibits a sense of dynamic posture, suggesting movement and engagement with each other. The artwork employs a monochromatic color scheme with sepia tones and bold, expressive lines.

artworks.title: Men Playing Boccie in a Village
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image displays a rural setting with hills, trees, and buildings. A detailed tree is prominently featured on the right, and a group of figures is seen on the left engaging in a leisure activity. The etching showcases intricate patterns and uses an earthy color palette.

artworks.title: Castle under Siege
artworks.medium: pen and brown-black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval landscape with a castle on a cliff in the distance. The drawing is in ink with detailed linework and hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in brown and black. People are active in the foreground, and a pathway leads to the castle where figures are approaching. The sky is lightly sketched with some clouds and birds flying.

artworks.title: Cavalry Battle near a River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene involving horses and figures. The composition is filled with dynamic movement, depicted using loose and energetic strokes. The subjects are entangled in what seems like a battle or a tumultuous event. The use of monochromatic tones and rapid lines creates a sense of frantic motion and an agitated atmosphere. The scene captures the essence of turbulence and activity, with elements like rearing horses and swirling dust clouds contributing to the animated feel of the image.

artworks.title: Worker at a Forge
artworks.medium: red and white chalks on buff laid paper, mounted on 18th -19th century album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated and pulling on a handle with both hands. He appears muscular and focused, with short hair and wearing loose shorts. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Three Men Fighting
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image is a pen and ink drawing featuring three figures. Two are standing and one is sitting on the ground. The figure on the left is shown in profile with curly hair and dressed in historical attire with voluminous sleeves. They hold an elongated object in one hand. The central figure sits on the ground with a distressed expression, wavy hair, and a detailed coat with decorative cuffs. The figure on the right stands with a large hat adorned with feathers, a long cloak, and rests a hand on a staff or cane. The background has minimal detail, with the focus on the three figures in the foreground. The lines are delicate and elegant, typical of sketch art.

artworks.title: Arch of Titus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows a historical architectural view depicted from a slightly lower angle, accentuating the grandeur of the ancient archway. The horizon is low in the scene, obscured by the monumental structure. The brushstrokes are intricate and sketch-like, capturing the complexity and texture of the ruins. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, giving the artwork an antiquated feel. The archway, richly decorated with towering columns, occupies central space, flanked by smaller ruins and scattered stones. Small figures, including one gesturing upward, provide scale as they interact with the space. Remnants of other structures can be seen in the distance, enhancing the historical setting. The background features trees and vague outlines of architectural elements blending with the sepia sky.

artworks.title: Horseman with Peasant
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person on horseback and a hooded figure. The scene depicts a figure on a horse and another figure standing beside the horse. The standing figure appears to be hooded, and both figures are placed on a lightly sketched ground, suggested by minimal lines indicating the terrain. The drawing is executed with loose and expressive lines, capturing a sense of movement and interaction between the subjects. The use of minimal shading and line work gives the artwork a sketch-like quality that focuses on the essence of the subjects rather than intricate detail.

artworks.title: Profile of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of a person in profile facing left. The person has a strong nose, prominent lips, and their features are depicted in a heavy, shadowed style. The hair is covered by a textured hat, and they wear simple clothing with a textured appearance. The background is shaded with closely drawn lines but lacks any discernible objects. No jewelry is visible, and the focus is on the person's facial features.

artworks.title: A Soldier on Horseback and Other Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and red chalk on laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing featuring multiple sketches, with the most prominent being a figure on horseback. The figure is shown from a three-quarter rear view, capturing most of the body of the horse and the rider. The rider's position is leaning slightly forward, holding a shield on their back, and pointing with their right arm extended outward. The facial features are obscured by a helmet, and the hair is not visible. The rider's clothing is indicative of armor, providing a sense of historical context, with details such as the helmet and shield being prominent. The horse is detailed, with its head in profile and showcasing the craftsmanship in the depiction of its mane. Around the rider, the background features additional sketches, including another rider in the upper right corner and a lightly sketched, unclothed figure in red chalk in the lower right area of the image. The background is a plain, textured surface, typical of aged paper, with no additional scenery or landscape details. The lack of color beyond the monochrome and red chalk emphasizes the drawing's nature as a study or draft.

artworks.title: A Helmeted Soldier
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body in a drawing. The man is in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. His facial features are bold, with an aquiline nose, deeply set eyes, pronounced cheekbones, and a well-defined chin. He has curly hair, a large mustache, and a beard. He wears an elaborate helmet with a plume, armored garment, and ornate shoulder protection with a lion's head. The background consists of parallel lines, and the drawing is done in a classic style, focusing on form and shading.

artworks.title: Seated Peasant
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Benjamin and Lillian Hertzberg
artworks.description: The drawing depicts the upper part of a person's body, from the waist up. The figure is seated and appears to be slightly hunched forward, with their arms bent at the elbows and hands resting in their lap. The facial features are detailed, showing an expressive face with prominent cheekbones, a pronounced nose, and tightly pursed lips. The hair is curly and appears to be receding or thinning, adding texture around the head. The person is wearing a buttoned garment with visible seams; the garment looks like it has a loose fit. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing attention solely on the drawn figure.
